patronOf.en-US: First priest of the Society of Jesus
patronOf.pt-BR: Primeiro sacerdote da Companhia de Jesus

prayerExcerpt.en-US: In the most crowded day we can make time briefly and secretly to lift our soul to God and draw new strength from Him.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: No dia mais atarefado podemos encontrar tempo, breve e secretamente, para elevar nossa alma a Deus e dele haurir novas forças.

meta.face: A Savoyard of about forty with a fair, lightly weathered mountain complexion and a BROAD, FULL face, as in his old portraits — a WIDE forehead, WIDE cheekbones, LARGE, WIDE-SET, clear dark-brown eyes, slightly PROMINENT, under thick, softly arched dark brows, a straight nose with a BROAD, rounded tip, FULL lips, a BROAD, rounded chin under a full, short, ROUNDED dark-brown beard and moustache; dark-brown hair under the biretta; a gentle, open, attentive gaze. Not the oval, curly-haired francis_xavier, the bald ignatius_loyola or the grey peter_canisius.
meta.basis: Early engraved portraits (one inscribed with his signature) show a broad face, large wide-set eyes, full lips and a short dark beard, in a biretta. The book tells the shepherd boy of Savoy, Ignatius's first companion and the first priest of the Society, who died in Rome in his fortieth year.
